title: Neurobiology, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: University Park. Built from the archived 2025-2026 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2025-2026/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/neurobiology-bs/), raw-HTML-verified word-for-word identical to the 2026-27 catalog's own Program Requirements text (same Prescribed/Additional Courses lists, same BIOL 222-or-322 genetics pick, same BMB 211-or-401, same CHEM 213W-or-213M, same PSYCH 260-or-BBH 203, same Group A/B/C/D 400-level course lists and 6/3/3/3-credit split, same "Supporting Courses and Related Areas: Select 19-20 credits from department list") and the same Suggested Academic Plan semester-by-semester table, including the identical confusing "BIOL 222 or 161 and 162" / "BIOL 322 or 161 and 162" phrasing this app's 2026 notes already document resolving. One real, cosmetic-only difference found: the 2025-26 edition's Suggested Academic Plan lists plain "BIOL 110" (4cr) / "BIOL 230W" (4cr) and "MATH 140B or 140" with a Total Credits range of 122-123, while the CURRENT (2026-27) live page has since been amended to also offer "BIOL 114 and 115" / "BIOL 114 and 116" as alternate paths into BIOL 110/230W and lists MATH 140B alone with a Total Credits range of 122-125 -- that BIOL-114/115/116 alternate-path addition is specific to the current 2026-27 edition (confirmed via raw HTML diff of the two editions' pages) and does not apply to this 2025 file, whose 'options' arrays correctly stay BIOL 110/BIOL 230W and MATH 140/140B/140H only, matching what this file's own archived edition actually offered. IMPORTANT FINDING: 2025-26 was this major's FIRST year as a standalone "Neurobiology, B.S." (plan code BNSC_BS) -- confirmed by fetching bulletins.psu.edu/archive/{2022-2023,2023-2024,2024-2025}/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/neurobiology-bs/, all three of which return a real HTTP 404 "Page Not Found" (verified via curl, not WebFetch), and by confirming via bulletins.psu.edu/archive/{2022-2023,2024-2025}/undergraduate/colleges/eberly-science/biology-bs/ that Neurobiology/Neuroscience instead existed only as a "Neuroscience Option" embedded inside Biology, B.S. (a shared-core, 46-55-credit option among six Biology options: Ecology, General Biology, Genetics and Developmental Biology, Neuroscience, Plant Biology, Vertebrate Physiology) through at least the 2024-25 catalog -- a genuinely different, non-standalone program structure (different plan code, different Gen-Ed/major credit split, option-specific rather than major-specific Program Requirements page) that this repo's NEURO files cannot honestly represent as "the same major, an earlier year." Per this task's no-fabrication guardrail, NEURO-2022.json, NEURO-2023.json, and NEURO-2024.json were deliberately NOT created for this reason -- see this session's final report for the full citation trail. All course content, the MATH 3/4/21/22 CHEM-110-prereq-chain fix, the Group A/B/C/D wiring, the 7 Supporting Course open_elective slots, and max_credits_per_semester=18 mirror NEURO-2026.json's own already-verified build unchanged, since the underlying bulletin requirements are identical between the two editions (BIOL-114/115/116 cosmetic exception noted above).
